title: Andrew Thomas's club and the Howard Theater in Washington
summary: Back in Washington he worked upstairs at Andrew Thomas's club at 7th and S, and soon at the Howard Theater.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, we stayed in, from there we came back -- we came back to Washington, D. C., but -- we came back to Washington, D. C. and I was working in a club there at 7th and S, and -- Andrew Thomas's place, 7th and S, that's what they called it. I used to work there upstairs and we had entertainers and the band and whatnot.
Was this at the same time that you were playing the show too, or had you left the show?
No, I mean -- oh the show? Yeah, we'd left the show, but I -- in a few -- couple of weeks after I worked there I joined -- I started working in the Howard Theater.
After you started working at Andrew Thomas's.
Yeah. I played at the Howard Theater, and the club.
See, and it was nice. They had quite a band there, and Howard Theater --
Who was in the band there?
